title: Mean curvature and sharp Willmore inequalities in metric spaces
summary: The goal of this work is to introduce a notion of mean curvature for level sets of functions in non-smooth spaces with Ricci curvature bounded below, and to prove that it satisfies sharp geometric inequalities. More precisely, we define a suitable Willmore functional $\mathcal{W}$ on Sobolev functions, whose domain of finiteness is dense in $L^p$ for any $1\le p<\infty$. For any function with finite Willmore energy, we show that almost all of its level sets admit a mean curvature vector satisfying the natural integration by parts formula with respect to the tangential divergence.
